rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Excellence
rows.Origin:
Bred by O.L. Weeks (1912-2002) (United States, before 2003).
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2004 as 'Excellence'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Moderate fragrance. 35 petals. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
